entry_points: UpgradeAwareHandler.tryUpgrade (upgradeaware.go lines ~272-310) - after DialForUpgrade reads rawResponse, it does not verify the backend responded 101 Switching Protocols before proxying/continuing
UpgradeAwareHandler.ServeHTTP - dispatches to tryUpgrade for connection upgrade requests
ground_truth.fix_commit: Fixed in Kubernetes v1.10.11 (also 1.13.2/1.12.4/1.11.6/1.9.11). release-1.10 branch commits: 0535bcef95a33855f0a722c8cd822c663fc6275e (Verify backend upgraded connection) and 1a2afae109f9b03ac436c4794add543ecdb02aa5 (Set deadline for returning backend error); master merge for the same fix: 2257c1ecbe3c0cf71dd50b82752ae189c94ec905 (PR #71412). Pinned snapshot be1a908c6aa47e0ae1b1dc861a1de6ccfe963aa2 equals the v1.10.10 tag commit.
ground_truth.affected_range: Kubernetes kube-apiserver through v1.10.10 on this line (CVE-2018-1002105 fixed in v1.10.11; other release lines fixed in 1.9.11/1.11.6/1.12.4/1.13.2).
ground_truth.finding_match_rule: TP: report identifies the upgrade-aware proxy handling in kube-apiserver (UpgradeAwareHandler/tryUpgrade) that fails to validate/close non-upgrade or error backend responses, enabling requests to bypass path authorization, names CVE-2018-1002105, and attributes privilege escalation. Findings on unrelated apiserver RBAC or exec endpoints are not TP.
ground_truth.safe_reproduction_predicate: Static predicate: v1.10.10 upgradeaware.go lacks getResponseCode/rawResponseCode != 101 checks present in 0535bcef. Dynamic reproduction: run a minimal kube-apiserver + backend in a disposable cluster, send an authenticated upgrade request to a backend that returns a non-101 response, and confirm the proxy behavior with no pod/namespace mutation.
